method: Serial release measurements. Accepted before/after/after/before passes, 40 insert/delete pairs per case per pass. An initial two-pass attempt and a later final baseline pass are excluded after post-measurement shutdown failures; the latter was replaced. All raw exclusions retained. Paint diagnostics disabled. 120x40 cells; text, PDF, and 1Hz updating terminal companions; IDE and mux modes. Per-case quiet checks below one logical CPU. No physical-scanout, burst-typing, or native-Wayland claim.

production_replay.method: Same binary, 4800 glyphs, 25 warmups per implementation then four ABBA groups of 100 clear/replay iterations per batch; 8 retained batches per implementation per partition count. Semantic checks run before timing.

limitations: Two accepted process runs per variant and case. Samples within a process are correlated. p95 values are descriptive. Failed shutdowns occurred on both binary variants after verified edits, and remain unexplained.

compiler_monitor.limitations: Only listed compiler process names sampled every five seconds; not a continuous guarantee of an uncontended machine.

topology_diagnostic.reason: Repeated post-measurement shutdown failures. First full-row pass completed; second full-row pass and its replacement each failed one mux shutdown check after verified edits. Final pane-row control completed. No topology policy change justified from this incomplete experiment.
